trigger: Player moves through entry, safehouse, street, survivor, route, transit, civic, or extraction space
state_contract: Classifies the current city zone from mission origin-relative anchors and selected-language run progress.
accessibility_contract: Zone state is mirrored through text-backed [Ambient] captions and game-instance summaries.

trigger: Character zone director samples a new active zone
state_contract: Stores the intended package-safe ambient bed key such as zone_entry_city_arrival, zone_safehouse_low_hum, or zone_extraction_rotor_wind.
accessibility_contract: No final audio asset is required; authored stems can bind to these stable bed keys later.

trigger: Terminal solved or survivor rescued state changes
state_contract: Changes survivor/extraction labels and bed hooks from locked/dormant to route-open/ready states.
accessibility_contract: Audio identity follows selected-language save progress without changing start-screen selection or save behavior.

trigger: Player crosses into a new zone after caption cooldown
state_contract: Publishes [Ambient]: city, zone, bed key, and selected language track.
accessibility_contract: Subtitles remain the accessible source of truth for ambience changes and future visualize-sound options.
